caption:
Your brain knows when you're lying on paper. Writing "I'm grateful" when your body says otherwise doesn't rewire anything — it teaches your brain the journal isn't a safe place to be honest. The Honest Page is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "JOURNAL" to get it. Save this for the night gratitude feels hollow. Send it to someone who journals every morning and still feels off.

#journaling #gratitude #overthinking #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: your gratitude journal is training your brain to lie
